title: b7z9.25.a: overlap-window arithmetic (R-02a-040) - py slot_coordination + rust multi_instance
description: Child of b7z9.25 (spec 02a 2a.5.3, R-02a-040): the overlap window = beacons within setup_window + occupied_time + guard window - the window arithmetic is ABSENT in all languages. Python: python/src/lichen/link/slot_coordination.py:303-357 (MultiRootState window is caller-scoped); Rust: rust/lichen-rpl/src/multi_instance.rs:1033-1103. Implement the combined-window overlap check in both, mirroring the C (b7z9.12/.24 track C), with unit tests per language. Vectors per the all-implementations rule if the overlap decision is observable on wire.
close_reason: DONE: R-02a-040 overlap-window arithmetic landed in Rust, completing the two-language parity for this requirement. The PYTHON side already implemented it (python/src/lichen/link/slot_coordination.py TdmaWindow :289-293 + MultiRootState.beacon_overlaps_window :390-415 with tests in tests/test_multi_root_rejoin.py) - the RUST side was missing. Added to rust/lichen-rpl/src/multi_instance.rs (commit 1a356187bd): TdmaWindow {slot_start_us, setup_window_us, occupied_time_us, guard_us} (std-gated, matching MultiRootState) and MultiRootState::beacon_overlaps_window(beacon_time_us, &window) -> bool mirroring the Python arithmetic exactly: window_start = slot_start - setup_window; window_end = slot_start + setup_window + occupied_time + guard; inclusive bounds. Tests: 3 new in-module cases mirroring the Python test_multi_root_rejoin.py cases (inside, before-window, after-window). Verification: lichen-rpl 321 passed / 0 failed (49 multi_instance incl. 3 new), fmt + clippy clean. C side tracked separately (b7z9.12/.24 per the parent bead).
